answer: Work-slot deposit bond: an identity claims one work slot on the reef board. Each claimant locks a 70-credit deposit and pays a 40 slot fee; work is due at dawn with a key-signed receipt. An umber auditor samples 5% of slots each epoch and re-runs the work; missing, late, or copied work burns the deposit. 1,000 fakes pay 110,000, 110 each, against a 40,000 pool. Rented slots fail: one receipt binds one key to one slot. Honest workers pay 40 once.
